newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia c.bank bill auction volume up, rates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Croatia c.bank bill auction volume up, rates mixed.

text.p: Volume at Croatia's central bank auction jumped to 350.1 million kuna on Wednesday from last week's 80.5 million as commercial banks bought more of five-and 13-week bills at mixed rates.
The five-week rate inched up to 7.99 from 7.95 percent as the bank accepted bids for 331.1 million kuna worth of paper.
It also sold 19 million kuna of its medium-term, 13-week bills at 9.42 percent, down 41 basis points.
Monday's reserve payment drained a total of 2.93 billion kuna from the banking sector or 44.6 million kuna more than previously, a bank official told Reuters.
